# Lionel Fairlie

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c21 P9](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0009)</sub>
- **Status:** Widower engaged to Harriet Ainslie  <sub>[v4 c21 P2](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Glen St. Agnes  <sub>[v4 c21 P2](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer and swine breeder  <sub>[v4 c18 P46](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0046)</sub>

## Appearance

Lionel is a tall, broad-shouldered, and handsome man. He has a high, unwrinkled pale forehead, fiery blue eyes, and a thick mane of red hair accompanied by a long, flowing red beard that shows no gray.

## Personality

Boisterous, loud, and stubborn, Lionel possesses a fiery temper and a roaring laugh. He speaks his mind bluntly and enjoys arguments, yet he is open-handed and harbors no genuine malice. Though intimidating when angered, he respects individuals who display courage and stand up to him.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P46](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0046)_

## Traits

- Boisterous and loud
- Stubborn
- Generous
- Outspoken and blunt

## Abilities

- Breeding champion swine  <sub>[v4 c18 P46](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0046)</sub>
- Adept at bickering and debate  <sub>[v4 c21 P1](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0001), [v4 c21 P12](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0012)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Harriet Ainslie  <sub>[v4 c21 P2](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0002)</sub>

## History

In his youth, Lionel Fairlie courted Harriet Ainslie, but following a disagreement he rashly married Dinah Coyle out of spite. His wife later passed away, leaving him a widower. After a dispute over a cow with a church elder, he stopped attending church services for twenty years. Years later, young Grace Ashdown confronted him at his farm to ask him to return to church and contribute to the minister's salary. Impressed by her fiery spirit when she berated him for his bluster, Lionel agreed to contribute generously and attend service once a month. His return to church reawakened his affection for Harriet Ainslie, whom he began pursuing openly. Harriet eventually agreed to release a past vow and accepted his proposal, leading to their planned autumn wedding.

_Sources: [v4 c15 P30](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0030), [v4 c15 P31](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0031), [v4 c17 P0](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0000), [v4 c21 P2](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0002), [v4 c22 P13](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0013), [v4 c22 P24](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0024)_
